name: Wix
description: Build, manage, and deploy Wix sites and apps. CLI development skills for dashboard extensions, backend APIs, site widgets, and service plugins with the Wix Design System, plus MCP server for site management.
longDescription:
Ships **8 skills** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (8): `wix-app` (Build and review Wix CLI app extensions — dashboard pages, modals, plugins, menu plugins, custom element widgets, Editor…), `wix-auth` (Authenticate with Wix to obtain an access token for calling Wix APIs), `wix-design-system` (Wix Design System component reference), `wix-docs` (Look up the Wix API/SDK documentation to confirm an exact endpoint, HTTP method, request/response shape, field, enum, or…), `wix-headless` (Connect Wix business services (Stores, Bookings, CMS, Blog, Events, Forms, and more) to a Wix Headless frontend —…), `wix-manage` (Wix business solution management recipes — REST API operations for configuring and managing Wix business solutions), `wix-replatform` (Routes RePlatform source-to-Wix migrations to the next workflow step by inspecting migration project artifacts), `wix-vibe-headless` (Client-only, dependency-free REST scaffolds for connecting an already-built front end (a vibe-coded app, an HTML/JSX/Vite project, a design-tool…)
- **MCP servers** (1): `wix-mcp`

Installs with `claude plugin install wix@claude-community` from `wix/skills`.
